purpose: Rules for targeted retrieval and update of reusable issue memory before and after generate-demo-animation tasks.

pre_task_retrieval.search_method: Use task tags, object names, and risk tags with rg/find. Read only matching issue entry ranges and selected lesson files.
do_not: Do not read all memory/lessons files.
Do not read all archived cases.
Do not read the entire issue log when targeted search is enough.
Do not skip memory retrieval before content analysis or implementation.
must_state_before_code: Issue IDs selected and their concrete rules.
Lesson IDs selected and their concrete rules, or that no relevant lesson was found.

pre_implementation_gates: Problem-understanding audit for givens, target, constraints, forbidden assumptions, and solution path.
HyperFrames or Remotion selected as the first implementation route.
Remotion/HyperFrames tooling checked or installed before implementation.
Self-check plan defined for logic, visual causality, layout, timing, and export.

issue_entry_schema.rule: The reusable rule to apply before implementation.
issue_entry_schema.source: Project or task where the issue occurred.

append_issue_when: The user points out a new reusable problem.
A new correction prevents a recurring visual, logic, timing, or export failure.
The current task explicitly includes updating this skill memory.
post_task_update.format: Append one compact Markdown entry with id, tags, trigger, mistake, fix, rule, and source.
